text:
maria: FYI ran quick q4b-int8 bring-up for model-x on longform holdout. EM dropped ~9% on our multi-paragraph QA golden.

kai: do we see hallucinations or span shifts? any tokenization diffs?

maria: mix of both. tokenizer normalization differs on em-dashes and code fences -> answer spans moved. also a handful of clear hallucinated facts.

ash: my hunch is the golden contains forum-sourced examples with noise. recommend pruning those to holdout and seeding golden with vetted editorial QA.

toni: how many noisy golden items?

maria: quick scan: ~160 of 1.1k look noisy (forums, stray context). propose: prune 160 -> holdout, add 200 vetted human-authored pairs.

ash: also proposed semantic dedupe at cosine>0.90 to surface paraphrase collisions. i'll run a pass and export top-300 ambiguous for relabel.

ash: SQL I used:

```sql
SELECT s.id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim
FROM staging.samplebank s
JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) > 0.90
AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 300;
```

labelops_bot: created LAB-17690 for 300 items. assignees sam + 2 contractors. ETA 72h.

sam: pulling the first 60. relabelers, mark: EXACT_CHANGE, HALLUCINATION, SPAN_SHIFT, NOISE_SOURCE. tag #quant4b-holdout.

kai: after relabel results, i'll run fp32 vs q4b-int8 bench with identical seeds and the updated golden. metrics: EM, F1, hallucination-rate (annotator flag), token-shift-count. if EM delta < 2% and hallucination down, canary to 5%.

maria: i pushed a tiny tokenizer normalizer PR in staging (PR#1195) to harmonize dash/quote normalization. testers please smoke.

toni: note 1: contractors bandwidth limited. is partial relabel useful? maybe prioritize multi-paragraph and code-block examples first.

ash: good call. labelops_bot: LAB-17690 update: 60/300 completed (20%).

sam: first batch returning. found 8 noisy forum examples and 12 span-shifts tied to punctuation. tagging accordingly.

maria: thanks. once 200 relabels done, kai please run bench. we'll reconvene with snapshots and decide prune+canary vs revert. :hourglass:

kai: will schedule bench and post qbench snapshot link here.
